item.title: Martin Gamperl: engineering Vienna’s global New Year’s Concert
item.description: Every year on Jan. 1, more than 50 million viewers around the world welcome the new year with the shimmering sound of the Vienna Philharmonic. item.title: Brain-music interface: Can brainwaves be transformed into music?
item.description: A neuroscientist and a musician are an unlikely duo. One analyzes electrical signals in the brain, while the other writes music that can shape those signals.
